business.name: TPCDS 248 仓库地理分布
business.description: 按国家和省州统计仓库数量、覆盖城市数及分组主键范围，保留空分组。global_min_warehouse_sk 为整个 warehouse 维表实际最小主键，每行重复同一全局值，允许后续库存查询直接绑定该值，不按返回行排名选择仓库。无参数、全仓库。

operation.statement:
SELECT
    w_country,                                              
    w_state,                                                
    COUNT(*)                AS warehouse_count,             
    COUNT(DISTINCT w_city)  AS city_count,                  
    MIN(w_warehouse_sk)     AS min_warehouse_sk,            
    MAX(w_warehouse_sk)     AS max_warehouse_sk,            
    (SELECT MIN(w_warehouse_sk) FROM warehouse)
                            AS global_min_warehouse_sk      
FROM warehouse
GROUP BY
    w_country,
    w_state
ORDER BY
    w_country,
    w_state
